actual_scope: On the published two-edge feed, no owner-indexed D-exponent-0 left map of the four final banks keeps x0 equal to D1 Q^{-1}, keeps y0 zero, and clears the three-term x1 block. Exactly one such index clears the D1 line of x1, and that index leaves the single monomial Q^{-1} C1 Q^2 C1 C3 D1 D3. The four banks stay stored.
scope_change_reason: The card allows one source-bound caller identity or an obstruction to that change. This package does not change the query demand and does not rerun the y0 defect, the declared alternating-family lock, or a feedback-edge test. It answers the x1-column question left by research/owner-indexed-y0-clearance, using the same four final banks. Nonzero D exponents, owner mixing, and a new feedback edge stay outside.
bottleneck_link: A productive main job has to be autonomous. An owner-indexed reading can clear y0 and the D1 part of x1, but every D-exponent-0 index that keeps x0 leaves a nonzero D1 D3 monomial in x1, so this feed still does not earn a new kappa.
stop_rule: Stop once every D-exponent-0 owner index that keeps x0 is shown to leave a nonzero x1 D1 D3 component, including the unique index that also clears y0 and the D1 line of x1. Do not search a new feedback edge or a nonzero D exponent.
evidence: PROOF.md and verify.py. The nonvanishing statement is an identity in the predecessor algebra plus the Q-letter parity character. The syllable-length-3 product check is a control, not an enumeration of the multiplier space. No kappa change.

open_questions.question: Can one owner-indexed multiplier whose D exponent is not zero cancel Q^{-1} C1 Q^2 C1 C3 D1 D3 while keeping x0 equal to D1 Q^{-1}, keeping y0 zero, and leaving the four final banks stored?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The D-exponent-0 proof separates the D1 line from the D1 D3 line. A coefficient with a nonzero D exponent can move one of those lines, so this obstruction does not forbid every owner-indexed map.
open_questions.first_step: Start from the unique D-exponent-0 index m0 = const C1, m1 = 0, m2 = Q^{-1} C1 Q^2 C1 Q, m3 = 0, and add one term of D exponent (0,-1) on a single bank. Recompute the four columns and require x0 and y0 to stay fixed.
open_questions.blocked_by: This package classifies only D-exponent 0. The predecessor excluded nonzero D exponents, and no such term is solved here.

open_questions.question: Does one physical relation omitted by this formal algebra send the residual word Q^{-1} C1 Q^2 C1 C3 to zero without collapsing Q^{-1} C1?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Nonvanishing is proved in the predecessor's sufficient algebra. A quotient that kills only the residual would remove this formal obstruction and would still not be an autonomous caller.
open_questions.first_step: Name one source relation that is not implied by Q^4 = C1^2 = C3^2 = I together with the inherited D conjugation rule, and reduce only the residual word by that relation.
open_questions.blocked_by: No further physical relation is imposed here. The predecessor already records that D^4 = I is not part of this algebra.
